3. Thursday. Tone [Bki] (Bk). [Commemoration of] Eugenius, Macarius, and companions. Father [Hymn] Tone [Gki] (Gk): "Who the wondrous" (Or zhrashapar).
5. Saturday. Tone [Gki] (Gk). [Commemoration of] the Holy Council of Ephesus and the two hundred Patriarchs.
6. Sunday. Tone [Dzi] (Dz). Fifth [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Bki] (Bk): "Unoriginate God" (Anskizbn astvats). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Dzi] (Dz): "Foreseeing the guards" (Papanantsn kankhelov). Barekendan [Eve] of the Fast of the Holy Mother of God.
7. Monday. Tone [Dki] (Dk). Fast of the Holy Mother of God. Father [Hymn of Fasting] Tone [Bi] (B2): "Who saved" (Or apretsu).
13. Sunday. Tone [Gki] (Gk). Assumption of the Holy Mother of God. The period of eating meat [non-fasting period] is four weeks.

26. Saturday. Tone [Bji] (Bz). [Commemoration of] Thomas the Apostle. See the First Volume, keeping the order of this place.

September

2. Saturday. Tone [Aki] (Ak). [Commemoration of] James and Simeon the Apostles. Read the Scriptures and the Gospel of the Tuesday of the Fast of Saint James.
3. Sunday. Tone [Dzi] (Dz). Fourth [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Gzi] (Gz): "We glorify Thee" (Paravoremk zkez). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Dzi] (Dz): "In the tomb" (I gerezman) and "They came to the tomb" (Ekin i gerezman).
4. Monday. Tone [Bki] (Bk). [Commemoration of] Andrew the Commander and his army, etc.
5. Tuesday. Tone [Gzi] (Gz). [Commemoration of] Adrian and his wife Anatolia, etc. Father [Hymn] Tone [Aki] (Ak): "Holy God" (Surb astvats).
7. Thursday. Tone [Dji] (Dz). [Commemoration of] Abraham and Khoren, Cosmas and Damian, and Astvatsatur the Martyr. Father [Hymn] Tone [Ki] (K): "Who is exalted" (Or bardzryal).
8. Friday. Tone [Dki] (Dk). Feast of the Nativity of the Holy Mother of God.
9. Saturday. Tone [Aji] (Az). [Commemoration of] the Holy Council of Nicaea and the three hundred and eighteen Patriarchs.
10. Sunday. Tone [Aki] (Ak). Fifth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Aki] (Ak): "Risen" (Harutsyal). Barekendan [Eve] of the Fast of the Holy Cross.
11. Monday. Tone [Bji] (Bz). Fast of the Holy Cross. Father [Hymn of Fasting] Tone [Bki] (Bk): "The voice of the youths" (Mankantsn zdayn).
17. Sunday. Tone [Azi] (Az). Exaltation of the Holy Cross. Until the tenth Sunday, see the First Volume; but for the Father [Hymns] of the martyrs and fasts, the Resurrection Evening Hymns [Hambartsi], and the tone of the days, see the Directory, keeping the [order of] the month.

November

Sunday. Tone [Dki] (Dk). Tenth [Sunday]. Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Dki] (Dk): "Thy angel, O Lord" (Hreshtak ko ter). Barekendan [Eve] of the Fast of Advent [Yisnak].
Monday. Tone [Aji] (Az). Fast of Advent. Father [Hymn] Tone [Dzi] (Dz): "Who in all things didst show" (Or yamenayni tsutser).
Tuesday. Tone [Aki] (Ak). Fast. Feast of the Presentation of the Holy Mother of God.
Saturday. Tone [Gki] (Gk). [Commemoration of] Saints Gregory and Nicholas the wonderworking Patriarchs, and the other Nicholas the Patriarch, and Myron the Bishop. Magnificat [Mankunk] poetic: "They were amazed" (Hiatsan). Midday [Chashu] Hymn Tone [Bi] (B2): "Who with light" (Or lusov).
Sunday. Tone [Dzi] (Dz). First [Sunday of Advent]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Aki] (Ak): "Unoriginate Word" (Anskizbn band). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Dzi] (Dz): "Awesome" (Ahagin) and "Who from above" (Or i verdes).
Monday. Tone [Dki] (Dk). [Commemoration of] Juliana and Vasilouhi. Father [Hymn] Tone [Gzi] (Gz): "They who hoped" (Yusatsyalkn). See also the rest in the First Volume.

December

Sunday. Tone [Gki] (Gk). Second [Sunday of Advent]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Bzi] (Bz): "Who art the King" (Or tagavort es). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Gki] (Gk): "Taking [flesh] from us" (Aryal yev mer).
Monday. Tone [Dji] (Dz). [Commemoration of] Gennarius, and Mercurius, and Yakovkos [James] and Iravapar.
Tuesday. Tone [Dki] (Dk). [Commemoration of] Abgar the King. The Scripture and Gospel are those of Theodosius.
Wednesday. Tone [Aji] (Az). Father [Hymn] Tone [Dki] (Dk): "O God of our fathers, have mercy" (Astvats hartsnh merots oghormya).
Saturday. Tone [Bki] (Bk). Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin by Anna.
Sunday. Tone [Gji] (Gz). Third [Sunday of Advent]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Bki] (Bk): "Who [the form] of a servant" (Or ztsarayi). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Gzi] (Gz): "Glorified is Thy" (Paravoryal e ko). Barekendan [Eve] of the Fast of Saint James.
Sunday. Tone [Bki] (Bk). Fourth [Sunday of Advent]. Father [Hymn] Tone [Gzi] (Gz): "Glorified Son of God" (Paravoryal ordi Astutso). Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone [Bi] (B2): "The women anticipated" (Kankhetsin kanaykn).
Saturday. Tone [Aki] (Ak). [Commemoration of] David the Prophet and James the Apostle.
